entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd like to hear about Agnolia.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'd like to hear about Agnolia.”
entries.menuText: “I'd like to hear about Agnolia.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I want to know more about Valgslan..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to know more about Valgsland.”
entries.menuText: “I want to know more about Valgsland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What's the latest situation in Weh..."
entries.dialogueText: “What's the latest situation in Wehlen?”
entries.menuText: “What's the latest situation in Wehlen?”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Our *brotherly* nation to our nort..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our *brotherly* nation to our north-east, Agnolia. They are still diplomatically non-aligned and probably has one of the most democratic systems between our neighbours.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Our cousins of old across the Mark..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our cousins of old across the Markian Sea wish to have good relations with us. As we all know, Valgsland is a socialist republic aligned with United Contana. They are an important regional player.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“It is tumultuous in the south, as..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is tumultuous in the south, as always. Wiktor Smolak is expanding his powers among protests from Wehzek people. However, he is quite positive about a normalisation of relationship between our countries.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Additionally, the latest numbers i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Additionally, the latest numbers indicate that currently, a million Agno-Sordish citizens live in the Agnland region of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They haven't been in good standing..."
entries.dialogueText: “They haven't been in good standing with us for the past two hundred years. Recently, they have also joined the Communist Contanan Security Pact, subjugating themselves to United Contana.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Our main goal should be to avoid a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our main goal should be to avoid a refugee crisis like the late 1920’s. That civil war had major security and economic repercussions on Sordish soil.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“In addition, a relaxed immigration..."
entries.dialogueText: “In addition, a relaxed immigration policy was one of Agnolia's main requests. Which is unacceptable. Most of the migrants in our country haven't even assimilated into Sordish culture. Adding more won't help.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Unfortunately, billions of Sordish..."
entries.dialogueText: “Unfortunately, billions of Sordish Ren worth of cargo is transported close to Valgslandian maritime borders on the Markian Sea and the Grey Strait.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Two important neighbouring countri..."
entries.dialogueText: “Two important neighbouring countries remain. Lespia and Rumburg. Which would you like to hear about first?”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Our southern neighbour is aligning..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our southern neighbour is aligning itself more and more with Arcasia. Lespia is currently led by Prime Minister Patricio Alvarez.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“You paid the price for your mistak..."
entries.dialogueText: “You paid the price for your mistake so it doesn't matter anymore.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Now to the most troublesome nation..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now to the most troublesome nation; Rumburg. A constitutional monarchy led by Queen Beatrice Livingston.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What about Lespia?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What about Lespia?”
entries.menuText: “What about Lespia?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What is the situation with Rumburg..."
entries.dialogueText: “What is the situation with Rumburg?”
entries.menuText: “What is the situation with Rumburg?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“There are hundreds of very privile..."
entries.dialogueText: “There are hundreds of very privileged oligarchs who invest inside and outside of Lespia. Some made significant business investments in the cities of Benfi and Valgen.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I am certain that the recession ha..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am certain that the recession has a lot to do with their retraction of investments. Once they see that money isn't in the picture they vanish rather quickly because they are capitalists.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We could use their aggressive atti..."
entries.dialogueText: “We could use their aggressive attitude against them by convincing the international community.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“While Thornbourgh openly denies su..."
entries.dialogueText: “While Thornbourgh openly denies such claims, their past and current actions make it clear that they want to destabilize us.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Unsurprisingly, the Agnolian Prime..."
entries.dialogueText: “Unsurprisingly, the Agnolian Prime Minister Maartin Van Hoorten is expecting better cooperation through a new, fairer trade deal with us. It was one of his election mandates.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We'll think about his request. The..."
entries.dialogueText: “We'll think about his request. The matter is still on the table.”
entries.menuText: “We'll think about his request. The matter is still on the table.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“A more comprehensive trade deal so..."
entries.dialogueText: “A more comprehensive trade deal sounds beneficial to all sides.”
entries.menuText: “A more comprehensive trade deal sounds beneficial to all sides.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Recently, the relationship has war..."
entries.dialogueText: “Recently, the relationship has warmed up thanks to Emmerich Hegel. As a result, diplomatic talks can be conducted in the future."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's not easy to forget about the..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's not easy to forget about the Great Fire of Conriat. Thousands of lives were lost that day.”
entries.menuText: “It's not easy to forget about the Great Fire of Conriat. Thousands of lives were lost that day.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Breaking the ice with Valgsland co..."
entries.dialogueText: “Breaking the ice with Valgsland could be good, if we are to rise diplomatically.”
entries.menuText: “Breaking the ice with Valgsland could be good, if we are to rise diplomatically.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked slightly worried."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked slightly worried.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“This causes significant risks to o..."
entries.dialogueText: “This causes significant risks to our imports and exports in the case of a deterioration in relations.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“But if we want to help them, we mu..."
entries.dialogueText: “But if we want to help them, we must not treat refugees like we did in the '30s. I still can’t stomach the inhumanity those people suffered.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“A trade agreement with them would..."
entries.dialogueText: “A trade agreement with them would improve stability and increase mutual trade.”
entries.menuText: “A trade agreement with them would improve stability and increase mutual trade.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why help such a disorganized state..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why help such a disorganized state? I'm not even sure what we can do to help them.”
entries.menuText: “Why help such a disorganized state? Not sure about what we can do to help them.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“They are strong and have the motiv..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are strong and have the motivation, as well as the means, to damage us. We shouldn't give them any reasons to pursue aggression.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will take your advice in conside..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will take your advice in consideration.”
entries.menuText: “I will take your advice in consideration.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Rumburg is and always will be a ro..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg is and always will be a rogue-like state. Nothing can be done about them.”
entries.menuText: “Rumburg is and always will be a rogue like state. Nothing can be done about them.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Lespia is a sleeping giant. We sho..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lespia is a sleeping giant. We should not awake them.”
entries.menuText: “Lespia is a sleeping giant. We should not awake them.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They keep turning a blind eye towa..."
entries.dialogueText: “They keep turning a blind eye towards the region, thinking that Lespia is above it all.”
entries.menuText: “They keep turning a blind eye towards the region. Thinking that Lespia is above it all.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They have shown a selfish attitude..."
entries.dialogueText: “They have shown a selfish attitude during the Wehlen Civil War by closing their borders and funnelling refugees to cross into Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“The weapons caches found by our in..."
entries.dialogueText: “The weapons caches found by our intelligence agency clearly shows what their goals are. Our military must be steadfast and our diplomacy valiant.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“It is in our national interest to..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is in our national interest to prevent the formation of a failed state on our western border.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“They are the jewel of the continen..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are the jewel of the continent and the second largest economy in Eastern Merkopa. Though wealthy, Lespia suffers from excessive economic inequality.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I highly advise caution and calcul..."
entries.dialogueText: “I highly advise caution and calculated action against Rumburg. Our military must be prepared, the threat is real.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I did what was right.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I did what was right.”
entries.menuText: “I did what was right.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Soldiers do not decide on what is..."
entries.dialogueText: “Soldiers do not decide on what is right. Soldiers do what they are told to do.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We are actively monitoring the sea..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are actively monitoring the sea routes and cargo ships. For now, there is no immediate threat. But we don't know what can happen in the future.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Wehlen has been increasingly align..."
entries.dialogueText: “Wehlen has been increasingly aligning itself towards the communist alliance, another point to analyse.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Our focus should be on the current..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our focus should be on the current matters. The Bludish minority is very large inside Wehlen too, which is a factor to consider.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He opened his mouth to say somethin..."
entries.dialogueText: He opened his mouth to say something but Deivid cut in.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“They surely are a powerful nation...."
entries.dialogueText: “They surely are a powerful nation. Despite that, they don't tend to meddle in the region and haven't for a long time, with the exception of Wehlen. Let's not antagonize them.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“The Lespian mentality is influence..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Lespian mentality is influenced by a certain aura of heroism and specialism. Their moral compass is different from ours.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“These types of nations will always..."
entries.dialogueText: “These types of nations will always try to make up a casus belli, a reason to declare war.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“We can act in our limits and make..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can act in our limits and make sure we are prepared for anything. Sword rattling is not advised in my opinion.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“They have shown similar behaviour..."
entries.dialogueText: “They have shown similar behaviour to their neighbouring countries before but we must be cautious.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We must prevent them from interfer..."
entries.dialogueText: “We must prevent them from interfering in our affairs.”
entries.menuText: “We must prevent them from interfering in our affairs.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“It could be but it would also mean..."
entries.dialogueText: “It could be but it would also mean that we would draw closer to the Arcasia block and near the Arcasian Treaty Organisation.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Allying with the richest regional..."
entries.dialogueText: “Allying with the richest regional nation could be beneficial.”
entries.menuText: “Allying with the richest regional nation could be beneficial.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef looked stern and full of reso..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef looked stern and full of resolve.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“We are always in dialogue with our..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are always in dialogue with our Rumburg ambassador to make sure a channel is open to solve disputes.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The Rumburg threat is one of our t..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Rumburg threat is one of our top priorities. You can be assured of that.”
entries.menuText: “The Rumburg threat is one of our top priorities. You can be assured of that.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Either way, treading carefully wit..."
entries.dialogueText: “Either way, treading carefully with them would be the safest bet.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I agree, some in our government ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree, some in our government are taking the issue out of proportion.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I think the threat is far too over..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think the threat is far too overblown.”
entries.menuText: “I think the threat is far too overblown.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I completely agree. Lespia has for..."
entries.dialogueText: “I completely agree. Lespia has for a long time benefited from us through our old tariffs. They are after exploitation.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our values are too different with..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our values are too different with Lespia. It will be hard to see eye to eye.”
entries.menuText: “Our values are too different with Lespia. It will be hard to see eye to eye.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Everything comes at a cost. In Les..."
entries.dialogueText: “Everything comes at a cost. In Lespia the cost is wealth inequality but business people are getting richer and richer.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The Capitalism of Lespia is inspir..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Capitalism of Lespia is inspirational to me. Look at their economic power.”
entries.menuText: “The Capitalism of Lespia is inspirational to me. Look at their economic power.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Their abrupt announcement about th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Their abrupt announcement about the closure of the Rumburg consulate in Lachaven is yet another step in their escalation.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: SharedSupport.Codex_History_ImportantEvents_AnnexationOfDome = true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian grabbed the Lachaven Times n..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian grabbed the Lachaven Times newspaper and put his finger on the article about the latest diplomatic incident.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“In fact, there had been a similar..."
entries.dialogueText: “In fact, there had been a similar refugee situation in the past. Even Mr. President himself chose to disobey direct orders from his commanding officer at the time.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was right, I did remember that w..."
entries.dialogueText: He was right, I did remember that winter. I remembered the despair in the refugees' eyes when we forcefully escorted them back to the Wehlen border.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Past is past. Let's move on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Past is past. Let's move on.”
entries.menuText: “Past is past. Let's move on.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“And you made me sleep in a prison..."
entries.dialogueText: “And you made me sleep in a prison cell for it. I will never forget that.”
entries.menuText: “And you made me sleep in a prison cell for it. I will never forget that.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He opened his mouth to continue but..."
entries.dialogueText: He opened his mouth to continue but Deivid cut in.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“That is the point of disciplinary..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is the point of disciplinary action.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Which creates a link between forei..."
entries.dialogueText: “Which creates a link between foreign policy and our internal affairs. These people have suffered socio-economically, which led them to crime and other problems.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Economic stagnation is a worry for..."
entries.dialogueText: “Economic stagnation is a worry for them. Their primary issue is their heavy reliance on foreign investment from us.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“It's also the most significant sea..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's also the most significant sea power in almost all of Merkopa. It is the only country that can rival the superpowers with their navy. We had hostile relations with them after several wars in the 19th century, which we wouldn't want to experience again.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Despite purging the Wehzek communi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Despite purging the Wehzek communists, reports indicate that they have been warming up to Contanan international aid. As you know, Wehlen’s stability was always a concern for the region.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We should maintain the existing ag..."
entries.dialogueText: “We should maintain the existing agreement. We can't lose our advantage.”
entries.menuText: “We should maintain the existing agreement. We can't lose our advantage.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“We could secure them as allies if..."
entries.dialogueText: “We could secure them as allies if we make concessions in a new agreement. Rumburg is our common threat.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“On top of that, territorial issues..."
entries.dialogueText: “On top of that, territorial issues have been flaring up between Agnolia and Valgsland because of the Heljiland Island. The Sordish Navy is very concerned with this volatile situation.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Both sides could gain from it but..."
entries.dialogueText: “Both sides could gain from it but Agnolia has more to win than us. They want to protect their weaker industries which we are profiting from selling our goods to.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“That would be the most pragmatic c..."
entries.dialogueText: “That would be the most pragmatic choice. Our export tariffs to Agnolia are incredibly low under the current agreement.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Holding grudges about the past wou..."
entries.dialogueText: “Holding grudges about the past wouldn't be a logical strategy if we are focusing on pragmatic foreign policy.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“There would be many bargaining chi..."
entries.dialogueText: “There would be many bargaining chips discussed, but Wehlen could be a new partner in the region. We would also invest in stability there.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“You should be. We have already wit..."
entries.dialogueText: “You should be. We have already witnessed several society shifting waves of migration.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I would re-think the matter seriou..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would re-think the matter seriously because it has great influence on our society and values.”

entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“One of the demands of President Sm..."
entries.dialogueText: “One of the demands of President Smolak was to tighten our immigration laws, so the political refugees don't escape to Sordland. There has been a recent purge that pushed many Bludish to flee to Bergia. It is definitely troubling.”
